title: Of Myths and Monsters

beats.what: Victor's extreme terror at a found yellow suit is witnessed; Boyd interprets it as a critical intelligence gap
Boyd authorizes Jade's mushroom trip over Donna's objection; frames it as wartime necessity
Tabitha reveals to Boyd she carries memories of other people and is terrified of the cost of accessing them
Sara tells Boyd the voices have returned with an instruction: pour and return a glass of water at the diner
Henry confronts Boyd about telling Victor what Miranda knew
Julie reads from the children's book that Storywalking requires a bookmark; team begins constructing one

character_beats.beat: While Ellis and Boyd treat her golem project as a warning sign, she is performing an act of self-authored hope; wants to be believed but is managed instead
Wants to access the memories that could save everyone but openly fears the cost after Jim's death; she names the paralysis rather than hiding it
Wants to refuse the voices, but compliance and refusal both carry consequences she cannot contain; she seeks counsel before acting

key_lines.line: I have memories in my head that belong to other people.
key_lines.why: Tabitha names the reincarnation burden in plain terms for the first time

key_lines.line: We are losing. Whatever game this is, we are losing.
key_lines.why: Boyd's private acknowledgment of systematic defeat, the only honest communique of the episode

key_lines.line: Only good people are tortured by the bad things that they've done.
key_lines.why: Sophia's moral reframe that allows Sara to believe rehabilitation is possible

open_loops: What is the man in the yellow suit, and is he the same entity Victor witnessed eating Miranda?
Sara has been instructed to contaminate the water pitcher; will she comply, and what is the true mechanism?
The bookmark for Storywalking is theorized but not yet built; what form does it take?
Ethan's belief that the Lake of Tears will heal Jim has not been tested against the Brundles result

payoffs.what: Lake of Tears phrase recurs: Tabitha accompanies Ethan toward the settlement to search for it, echoing the dream Ethan had the first night in the RV

contradiction.wants: To protect every person in his care, naming no one expendable
contradiction.does: Authorizes Jade's potentially fatal mushroom trip and, in the same conversation, acknowledges the community is losing, treating acceptable casualties as already factored in

tone_notes: The episode's longest silence is 117.5 seconds (07:46-09:44), the widest gap in the season to this point, spanning Victor's collapse at the yellow suit. The density map shows a dead zero at minute 9 (0 words) inside that silence. Two sharp density spikes bracket the mushroom-trip preparation: minute 3 (184) and minute 5 (163). The overall 85 words/min is steady mid-range, but the structural silence at minute 9 acts as an episodic load-bearing pause around which the rest of the hour pivots.
